# CLI reference

Every command that touches a run folder takes the run directory as an explicit
positional argument, so there is no ambient 'current run' state and a shell history is
self-contained and replayable. `--format json` (the default on most commands) makes every
command's output machine-readable.

This page is generated from the typer application, so it cannot describe a flag that does
not exist. `gelpy <command> --help` prints the same information at the terminal.

## Options of `gelpy` itself

Before any command name, as in `gelpy --version`.

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--version` | `boolean` |  | Print the gelpy version and exit. |
| `--install-completion` | `boolean` |  | Install completion for the current shell. |
| `--show-completion` | `boolean` |  | Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation. |


## `gelpy background`

Configure and inspect background removal.

### `gelpy background remove`

Configure background removal (applied lazily by the pipeline).

| argument | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_DIR` | `text` | **required** | Existing run folder. |

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--model` | `text` | `robust_plane` | Background model name (see `models list`). |
| `--order` | `integer` |  | robust_plane surface order (0/1/2). |
| `--mode` | `text` |  | robust_plane weight mode: 'probabilistic' or 'asymmetric'. |
| `--clip-negative`, `--no-clip-negative` | `boolean` |  | Clamp negatives to 0 (default: keep signed residuals — no rectification bias). |
| `--param` | `text (repeatable)` |  | Extra model param 'key=value' (repeatable). |
| `--stripe` | `text (repeatable)` |  | plane_ransac stripe 'pos,height' (repeatable). |
| `--plot`, `--no-plot` | `boolean` |  | Also render the background diagnostic figure. |
| `--format` | `text` | `json` | Output format: json\|text. |

### `gelpy background show`

|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_DIR` | `text` | **required** | Existing run folder. |

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | `text` | `json` | Output format: json\|text. |

## `gelpy fit`

Fit peaks to line profiles.

### `gelpy fit refit-lane`

Refit one lane, changing only the options you pass (merged onto its last settings).

| argument | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_DIR` | `text` | **required** | Existing run folder. |

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--lane` | `text` |  | Single lane selector term. |
| `--method` | `text` |  | Fit strategy to switch to. |
| `--slice` | `<integer integer>` |  |  |
| `--normalization` | `text` |  |  |
| `--shapes` | `text` |  | Comma-separated allowed shapes. |
| `--baseline` | `text` |  | Baseline method to switch to. |
| `--poly-order` | `integer` |  | Polynomial baseline order (default 2; see `fit run --help`). |
| `--seed` | `integer` |  | RNG seed. |
| `--auto-escalate` | `boolean` |  | Climb tiers on low confidence. |
| `--plot`, `--no-plot` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `--allow-raw` | `boolean` |  | Measure the raw image although no background removal is configured (refused otherwise: background_required). |
| `--format` | `text` | `json` | Output format: json\|text. |

### `gelpy fit run`

Run a full fit pass over a lane selection (no manual peak-detection tuning needed).

| argument | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_DIR` | `text` | **required** | Existing run folder. |

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--lane` | `text (repeatable)` |  | Lane selector term (repeatable). |
| `--method` | `text` | `grow_select` | Fit strategy: grow_select\|sparse_seed\|bayesian. |
| `--slice` | `<integer integer>` |  | start end. |
| `--normalization` | `text` | `area` | area\|min_max\|safe. |
| `--shapes` | `text` |  | Comma-separated allowed shapes (default: all). |
| `--baseline` | `text` |  | Baseline: poly\|arpls\|asls\|none (default poly). |
| `--poly-order` | `integer` |  | Polynomial baseline order (default 2). Use 0 (constant) when fitting a slice that starts right after a hard exclusion boundary (e.g. past a well-cavity dip) — order >=1 has enough freedom to bend up and absorb a real smear once there's no anchoring feature left in the window to hold it down. |
| `--seed` | `integer` |  | RNG seed (reproducible bayesian tier). |
| `--auto-escalate` | `boolean` |  | Climb tiers on low confidence. |
| `--plot`, `--no-plot` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `--allow-raw` | `boolean` |  | Measure the raw image although no background removal is configured (refused otherwise: background_required). |
| `--format` | `text` | `json` | Output format: json\|text. |

## `gelpy lanes`

Configure lane positions and labels.

### `gelpy lanes detect`

Detect lane centers from the image (fit an even N-lane grid) and render an overlay to verify.

| argument | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_DIR` | `text` | **required** | Existing run folder. |

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--n-lanes` | `integer` |  | True lane count (ground truth); defaults to the current recipe count. |
| `--y-start` | `integer` |  | Top row of the projection band. |
| `--y-end` | `integer` |  | Bottom row of the projection band (try the well region for faint lanes). |
| `--smoothing-window` | `float` |  | Moving-window average width (px) applied before peak detection (default: 0.7x the expected pitch). Wells are plateaus, often brighter on one edge than the other — averaging over a considerable width prevents that from biasing the center. |
| `--prominence` | `float` |  | Peak prominence floor; raise to drop spurious peaks. |
| `--distance` | `float` |  | Min px between peaks. |
| `--min-width` | `float` |  | Minimum peak width in px (default: off). No universally safe scaled default exists (a real narrow band and a dust spike can be equally narrow) — compare widths in the overlay first, then set this above the spurious ones but below the genuine ones. |
| `--corrected` | `boolean` |  | Detect on the background-corrected image (default: raw). |
| `--projection-strategy` | `text` | `d4_union` | Row-aggregation strategy for the projection ('d4_union' = multi-band union, default; 'full' = full-height mean). The default is only adopted if it beats full-height, so it is never worse than 'full'. |
| `--apply` | `boolean` |  | Persist the detected centers to the recipe. |
| `--plot`, `--no-plot` | `boolean` | `True` | Render the verification overlay. |
| `--labels-file` | `text` |  | Labels to apply (with --apply). |
| `--label-rotation` | `float` |  | Label rotation (deg). |
| `--format` | `text` | `json` | Output format: json\|text. |

### `gelpy lanes pick`

Interactively click lane centers on the image — opt-in human fallback for `lanes detect`. Needs a GUI/display, not for headless/agent use. Click the two outer lane centers (or, with --all, every lane) on the high-contrast image, then press Enter; with just the two outer clicks the rest are spread evenly (same as `lanes set --endpoints`).

| argument | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_DIR` | `text` | **required** | Existing run folder. |

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--n-lanes` | `integer` |  | True lane count (ground truth); defaults to the current recipe count. |
| `--all` | `boolean` |  | Click every lane center instead of just the two outer ones. |
| `--corrected` | `boolean` |  | Show the background-corrected image (default: raw). |
| `--labels-file` | `text` |  | Newline-separated labels file. |
| `--width` | `integer` |  | Profile strip width (px). |
| `--format` | `text` | `json` | Output format: json\|text. |

### `gelpy lanes set`

Set lane positions / labels / width.

| argument | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_DIR` | `text` | **required** | Existing run folder. |

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--linspace` | `<float float integer>` |  | left right n — evenly spaced lane centers. |
| `--endpoints` | `<float float>` |  | left right — outer lane centers; linspaced with --n-lanes (manual fallback). |
| `--x-center` | `float (repeatable)` |  | Explicit lane center x-position (repeatable). |
| `--n-lanes` | `integer` |  | Lane count for --endpoints. |
| `--labels-file` | `text` |  | Newline-separated labels file. |
| `--width` | `integer` |  | Profile strip width (px). |
| `--label-rotation` | `float` |  | Label rotation (deg). |
| `--format` | `text` | `json` | Output format: json\|text. |

## `gelpy mcp`

Serve the agent tools over the Model Context Protocol on stdin/stdout. Needs the optional dependency: pip install "gelpy[mcp]". Register it with an MCP client, for example `claude mcp add gelpy -- gelpy mcp`.


## `gelpy models`

Discover available models.

### `gelpy models list`

List available models, their descriptions, and their parameter schemas. ``fit`` = fit strategies (grow_select/sparse_seed/bayesian); ``shape`` = peak shapes (gaussian/emg/bi_gaussian/pseudo_voigt); ``background`` = background models.

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--kind` | `text` | `fit` | fit\|shape\|background |
| `--format` | `text` | `json` | Output format: json\|text. |

## `gelpy report`

Write reports of a run folder.

### `gelpy report html`

Write a static HTML report of the run folder: one page, a stylesheet and its images, no scripts.

| argument | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_DIR` | `text` | **required** | Existing run folder. |

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--css` | `text` |  | Path of a UTF-8 stylesheet file (at most 1 MiB), copied unparsed as theme.css and loaded after the default; its references are yours (a relative url() resolves against the report folder). |
| `--out` | `text` |  | Folder to write the report into (default: RUN_DIR/report). It must be new, empty or hold the output of an earlier report html: any other non-empty folder is refused, and so are the run folder and the folders inside or around it (but report/). A rebuild replaces only the files that earlier build wrote. One report per folder. |
| `--format` | `text` | `json` | Output format: json\|text. |

## `gelpy tool`

Discover and call the agent tools: one JSON object in, one JSON object out.

### `gelpy tool call`

Run one tool: read one JSON object, write one JSON object (an error on stderr).

| argument | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | `text` | **required** | Tool name (see `gelpy tool list`). |

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--input` | `text` | `-` | File holding the JSON object (UTF-8; a byte order mark is ignored); '-' (the default) reads stdin. |

### `gelpy tool list`

List the agent tools (`gelpy tool call NAME` runs one).

| option | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | `boolean` |  | Print every tool's name, title, description, input and output JSON Schema, annotations and path arguments. |
